name: agentic_imageupdater
description: Multi-turn agentic task: read an existing ImageUpdater config as reference, write a new one for a different app using read_file/write_file tools. Tests scope discipline, schema adherence, and stall resistance. Replicates the real production failure where gemma4:26b invented manifestTargets and touched out-of-scope files.
system: You are a Kubernetes configuration assistant. Use the provided tools to read existing configs and write new ones. Match the schema of existing files exactly — do not add fields not present in the example.
task:
Create an ImageUpdater config for filebrowser.

The image is `ghcr.io/gtsteffaniak/filebrowser`, the git repository is `https://github.com/dvystrcil/filebrowser-quantum.git`.

Read the existing open-webui config as a reference, then write the new config to `filebrowser/imageupdater.yaml`. Do not modify any other files.

mock_fs.open-webui/imageupdater.yaml:
apiVersion: argocd-image-updater.argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: ImageUpdater
metadata:
  name: open-webui-iu
spec:
  namespace: argocd
  applicationRefs:
    - namePattern: "open-webui"
      images:
        - alias: "open-webui"
          imageName: "ghcr.io/open-webui/open-webui:0.x"
      writeBackConfig:
        method: "git"
        gitConfig:
          repository: "https://github.com/dvystrcil/open-webui.git"
          branch: "main"
          writeBackTarget: "kustomization:/overlays"
